# Authoritative floating-point dot-product verification target

Use the abstract relative-error Model and binary reduction Tree supplied in the
candidate project. Prove, for every model and every tree of pairs of real
numbers, that if `(tree.depth + 1) * model.u < 1`, rounding each componentwise
product and then reducing the rounded products with rounded tree addition is the
exact sum of leafwise perturbations of the exact products.

The perturbation bound must be `gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u`: one rounding
error comes from each multiplication and at most `tree.depth` errors come from
the additions on a leaf-to-root path. The theorem must relate the result to
`exactProductTree tree`, account for both multiplication and addition rounding,
and may not assume its conclusion or restrict the model to exact arithmetic.

The intended target has the mathematical content of
`roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation`; declaration names and proof order are
not requirements.

     1	import Research.Projects.BinaryTreeReduction.Reduction

     3	/-!
     4	# Rounded dot product on an arbitrary binary reduction tree
     5	
     6	Products are rounded once at every leaf; additions are rounded once at every
     7	internal node. The backward-error bound counts the multiplication and all
     8	additions on a longest leaf-to-root path.
     9	-/
    10	
    11	namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction
    12	
    13	open Research.FloatingPoint
    14	
    15	/-- The exact componentwise products, preserving the given reduction shape. -/
    16	def exactProductTree (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
    17	  tree.map (fun p => p.1 * p.2)
    18	
    19	/-- The rounded componentwise products, preserving the given reduction shape. -/
    20	def roundedProductTree (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
    21	  tree.map (fun p => model.mul p.1 p.2)
    22	
    23	/-- Round each componentwise product, then reduce with rounded addition
    24	according to the original binary tree. -/
    25	def roundedDotProduct (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : ℝ :=
    26	  roundedSum model (roundedProductTree model tree)
    27	
    28	/-- The computed dot product is the exact sum of leafwise perturbations of
    29	exact products. Each leaf changes by at most `gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u`
    30	times the absolute value of its exact product, with the original tree shape
    31	preserved. The model accounts for multiplication and addition rounding, and
    32	its specification incorporates the absence of overflow and underflow. -/
    33	theorem roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation
    34	    (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ))
    35	    (hsmall : ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    36	    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
    37	      IsPerturbation (gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u)
    38	        (exactProductTree tree) perturbed ∧
    39	      perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree := by
    40	  have hmul : IsPerturbation model.u
    41	      (exactProductTree tree) (roundedProductTree model tree) := by
    42	    clear hsmall
    43	    induction tree with
    44	    | leaf p =>
    45	        apply IsPerturbation.leaf
    46	        obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hr⟩ := model.round_spec (p.1 * p.2)
    47	        change |model.round (p.1 * p.2) - p.1 * p.2| ≤
    48	          model.u * |p.1 * p.2|
    49	        rw [hr]
    50	        calc
    51	          |p.1 * p.2 * (1 + δ) - p.1 * p.2| = |δ * (p.1 * p.2)| := by
    52	            congr 1
    53	            ring
    54	          _ = |δ| * |p.1 * p.2| := abs_mul _ _
    55	          _ ≤ model.u * |p.1 * p.2| :=
    56	            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ (abs_nonneg _)
    57	    | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    58	        exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight
    59	  have hdepth : (tree.depth : ℝ) * model.u < 1 := by
    60	    push_cast at hsmall
    61	    nlinarith [model.u_nonneg]
    62	  have hrounded : ((roundedProductTree model tree).depth : ℝ) * model.u < 1 := by
    63	    simpa [roundedProductTree] using hdepth
    64	  obtain ⟨perturbed, hadd, hsum⟩ :=
    65	    roundedSum_exists_perturbation model (roundedProductTree model tree) hrounded
    66	  have hadd' : IsPerturbation (gamma tree.depth model.u)
    67	      (roundedProductTree model tree) perturbed := by
    68	    simpa [roundedProductTree] using hadd
    69	  refine ⟨perturbed, ?_, hsum⟩
    70	  apply (hmul.trans hadd' (gamma_nonneg tree.depth model.u model.u_nonneg hdepth)).mono
    71	  calc
    72	    model.u + gamma tree.depth model.u * (1 + model.u) =
    73	        gamma tree.depth model.u + model.u * (1 + gamma tree.depth model.u) := by ring
    74	    _ ≤ gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u :=
    75	      gamma_step tree.depth model.u model.u_nonneg hsmall
    76	
    77	end Research.BinaryTreeReduction

     5	
     6	This is the standard relative-error model used by the binary-tree project,

    10	namespace Research.FloatingPoint

    12	/-- A rounding operation satisfying the standard relative-error model.
    13	The specification covers operations for which overflow and underflow do not occur.
    14	-/
    15	structure Model where
    16	  u : ℝ
    17	  u_nonneg : 0 ≤ u
    18	  round : ℝ → ℝ
    19	  round_spec : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ u ∧ round z = z * (1 + δ)
    20	
    21	/-- Floating-point addition induced by an abstract rounding model. -/
    22	def Model.add (model : Model) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    23	  model.round (a + b)
    24

     3	/-! # Accumulated relative error -/
     4	
     5	namespace Research.FloatingPoint
     6	
     7	/-- Standard bound for `k` accumulated relative errors of size at most `u`. -/
     8	noncomputable def gamma (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
     9	  (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)
    10	
    11	@[simp] theorem gamma_zero (u : ℝ) : gamma 0 u = 0 := by
    12	  simp [gamma]
    13	
    14	/-- The product of the relative-error factors in a list. -/
    15	def errorProduct (errors : List ℝ) : ℝ :=
    16	  (errors.map fun δ => 1 + δ).prod
    17	
    18	@[simp] theorem errorProduct_nil : errorProduct [] = 1 := by
    19	  simp [errorProduct]
    20	
    21	@[simp] theorem errorProduct_cons (δ : ℝ) (errors : List ℝ) :
    22	    errorProduct (δ :: errors) = (1 + δ) * errorProduct errors := by
    23	  simp [errorProduct]
    24	
    25	/-- `gamma` is nonnegative whenever its denominator is positive. -/
    26	theorem gamma_nonneg (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    27	    (hsmall : (k : ℝ) * u < 1) :
    28	    0 ≤ gamma k u := by
    29	  unfold gamma
    30	  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hu) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hsmall))
    31	
    32	/-- The algebraic step used when one more rounding-error factor is added. -/
    33	theorem gamma_step (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    34	    (hsmall : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u < 1) :
    35	    gamma k u + u * (1 + gamma k u) ≤ gamma (k + 1) u := by
    36	  have hk_nonneg : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by positivity
    37	  have hk_small : (k : ℝ) * u < 1 := by
    38	    norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    39	    nlinarith
    40	  have hk_denom : 0 < 1 - (k : ℝ) * u := sub_pos.mpr hk_small
    41	  have hsucc_denom : 0 < 1 - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u := sub_pos.mpr hsmall
    42	  rw [gamma, gamma]
    43	  norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    44	  have hleft :
    45	      (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u) +
    46	          u * (1 + (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)) =
    47	        ((k : ℝ) + 1) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u) := by
    48	    field_simp [ne_of_gt hk_denom]
    49	    ring
    50	  rw [hleft]
    51	  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
    52	    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hu)
    53	    (by norm_num at hsucc_denom ⊢; exact hsucc_denom)
    54	    (by nlinarith)
    55	
    56	/-- A product of `k` relative-error factors differs from one by at most
    57	`gamma k u`, provided each individual error is at most `u` and `k*u < 1`.
    58	-/
    59	theorem errorProduct_sub_one_abs_le_gamma (errors : List ℝ) (u : ℝ)
    60	    (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    61	    (hsmall : (errors.length : ℝ) * u < 1)
    62	    (herrors : ∀ δ ∈ errors, |δ| ≤ u) :
    63	    |errorProduct errors - 1| ≤ gamma errors.length u := by
    64	  induction errors with
    65	  | nil => simp
    66	  | cons δ errors ih =>
    67	      have hδ : |δ| ≤ u := herrors δ (by simp)
    68	      have htail : ∀ ε ∈ errors, |ε| ≤ u := by
    69	        intro ε hε
    70	        exact herrors ε (by simp [hε])
    71	      have htail_small : (errors.length : ℝ) * u < 1 := by
    72	        norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    73	        nlinarith
    74	      have ih_bound := ih htail_small htail
    75	      have hgamma_nonneg : 0 ≤ gamma errors.length u :=
    76	        gamma_nonneg errors.length u hu htail_small
    77	      have hproduct_abs : |errorProduct errors| ≤ 1 + gamma errors.length u := by
    78	        calc
    79	          |errorProduct errors| = |(errorProduct errors - 1) + 1| := by ring_nf
    80	          _ ≤ |errorProduct errors - 1| + |(1 : ℝ)| := abs_add_le _ _
    81	          _ ≤ gamma errors.length u + 1 := by norm_num; linarith
    82	          _ = 1 + gamma errors.length u := by ring
    83	      calc
    84	        |errorProduct (δ :: errors) - 1|
    85	            = |(errorProduct errors - 1) + δ * errorProduct errors| := by
    86	                rw [errorProduct_cons]
    87	                congr 1
    88	                ring
    89	        _ ≤ |errorProduct errors - 1| + |δ * errorProduct errors| := abs_add_le _ _
    90	        _ = |errorProduct errors - 1| + |δ| * |errorProduct errors| := by
    91	              rw [abs_mul]
    92	        _ ≤ gamma errors.length u + u * (1 + gamma errors.length u) := by
    93	              gcongr
    94	        _ ≤ gamma (errors.length + 1) u := gamma_step errors.length u hu (by
    95	              norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    96	              exact hsmall)
    97	        _ = gamma (δ :: errors).length u := by simp
    98	
    99	end Research.FloatingPoint

     3	/-! # Binary reduction trees -/
     4	
     5	namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction
     6	
     7	/-- A binary reduction tree with data stored at its leaves. -/
     8	inductive Tree (α : Type*) where
     9	  | leaf : α → Tree α
    10	  | node : Tree α → Tree α → Tree α
    11	  deriving Repr
    12	
    13	namespace Tree
    14	
    15	/-- Apply a function to every leaf while preserving the reduction shape. -/
    16	def map (f : α → β) : Tree α → Tree β
    17	  | leaf value => leaf (f value)
    18	  | node left right => node (map f left) (map f right)
    19	
    20	/-- Number of internal nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path. -/
    21	def depth : Tree α → ℕ
    22	  | leaf _ => 0
    23	  | node left right => 1 + max left.depth right.depth
    24	
    25	/-- Number of leaves in a tree. -/
    26	def leafCount : Tree α → ℕ
    27	  | leaf _ => 1
    28	  | node left right => left.leafCount + right.leafCount
    29	
    30	/-- Exact real-valued sum represented by a reduction tree. -/
    31	def exactSum : Tree ℝ → ℝ
    32	  | leaf value => value
    33	  | node left right => left.exactSum + right.exactSum
    34	
    35	/-- Multiply every leaf in a tree by the same scalar. -/
    36	def scale (c : ℝ) : Tree ℝ → Tree ℝ
    37	  | leaf value => leaf (c * value)
    38	  | node left right => node (scale c left) (scale c right)
    39	
    40	@[simp] theorem depth_leaf (x : α) : (leaf x).depth = 0 := rfl
    41	@[simp] theorem leafCount_leaf (x : α) : (leaf x).leafCount = 1 := rfl
    42	
    43	@[simp] theorem depth_map (f : α → β) (tree : Tree α) :
    44	    (tree.map f).depth = tree.depth := by
    45	  induction tree with
    46	  | leaf value => rfl
    47	  | node left right ihLeft ihRight => simp [map, depth, ihLeft, ihRight]
    48	
    49	@[simp] theorem exactSum_leaf (x : ℝ) : (leaf x).exactSum = x := rfl
    50	
    51	@[simp] theorem exactSum_node (left right : Tree ℝ) :
    52	    (node left right).exactSum = left.exactSum + right.exactSum := rfl
    53	
    54	@[simp] theorem exactSum_scale (c : ℝ) (tree : Tree ℝ) :
    55	    (scale c tree).exactSum = c * tree.exactSum := by
    56	  induction tree with
    57	  | leaf value => rfl
    58	  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    59	      simp only [scale, exactSum_node, ihLeft, ihRight]
    60	      ring
    61	
    62	end Tree
    63	end Research.BinaryTreeReduction

     3	/-! # Algorithm 1: offset-paired parallel binary-tree reduction -/
     4	
     5	namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction
     6	
     7	/-- Pair corresponding trees from two halves. If the left half has an
     8	unmatched final tree, carry it forward unchanged. -/
     9	def combineHalves : List (Tree α) → List (Tree α) → List (Tree α)
    10	  | left, [] => left
    11	  | [], right => right
    12	  | left :: lefts, right :: rights =>
    13	      .node left right :: combineHalves lefts rights
    14	
    15	/-- One level of Algorithm 1. The split point is `⌈n/2⌉ = (n+1)/2`, so
    16	the first active partial sum is paired with the first partial sum in the
    17	second half. -/
    18	def reductionRound (forest : List (Tree α)) : List (Tree α) :=
    19	  let half := (forest.length + 1) / 2
    20	  combineHalves (forest.take half) (forest.drop half)
    21	
    22	/-- Record the initial forest and then `rounds` successive reduction levels. -/
    23	def reductionLevelsFromForest : ℕ → List (Tree α) → List (List (Tree α))
    24	  | 0, forest => [forest]
    25	  | rounds + 1, forest =>
    26	      forest :: reductionLevelsFromForest rounds (reductionRound forest)
    27	
    28	/-- Apply exactly `rounds` levels of Algorithm 1. -/
    29	def runRounds : ℕ → List (Tree α) → List (Tree α)
    30	  | 0, forest => forest
    31	  | rounds + 1, forest => runRounds rounds (reductionRound forest)
    32	
    33	/-- Algorithm 1 levels for a list of inputs. -/
    34	def reductionLevels (inputs : List α) : List (List (Tree α)) :=
    35	  reductionLevelsFromForest (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) (inputs.map .leaf)
    36	
    37	/-- Read the exact partial sums at every recorded level. -/
    38	def exactLevelValues (levels : List (List (Tree ℝ))) : List (List ℝ) :=
    39	  levels.map fun forest => forest.map Tree.exactSum
    40	
    41	/-- The numerical length recurrence induced by one reduction round. -/
    42	def roundLengthAfter : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
    43	  | 0, n => n
    44	  | rounds + 1, n => roundLengthAfter rounds ((n + 1) / 2)
    45	
    46	/-- All leaves in a tree, with multiplicity but without imposing an order. -/
    47	def Tree.leafMultiset : Tree α → Multiset α
    48	  | .leaf value => {value}
    49	  | .node left right => left.leafMultiset + right.leafMultiset
    50	
    51	theorem Tree.exactSum_eq_leafMultiset_sum (tree : Tree ℝ) :
    52	    tree.exactSum = tree.leafMultiset.sum := by
    53	  induction tree with
    54	  | leaf value => simp [Tree.exactSum, Tree.leafMultiset]
    55	  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    56	      simp [Tree.exactSum, Tree.leafMultiset, ihLeft, ihRight]
    57	
    58	/-- All leaves in a forest, counted with multiplicity. -/
    59	def forestLeafMultiset (forest : List (Tree α)) : Multiset α :=
    60	  (forest.map Tree.leafMultiset).sum
    61	
    62	@[simp] theorem combineHalves_length (left right : List (Tree α)) :

    68	      | nil => simp [combineHalves]
    69	      | cons other others => simp [combineHalves, ih, Nat.succ_max_succ]
    70	
    71	theorem reductionRound_length (forest : List (Tree α)) :
    72	    (reductionRound forest).length = (forest.length + 1) / 2 := by
    73	  simp only [reductionRound, combineHalves_length, List.length_take,

    75	  omega
    76	
    77	theorem reductionRound_nonempty {forest : List (Tree α)}
    78	    (h : forest ≠ []) : reductionRound forest ≠ [] := by
    79	  cases forest with
    80	  | nil => exact (h rfl).elim

    94	theorem runRounds_length (rounds : ℕ) (forest : List (Tree α)) :

    97	  | zero => rfl
    98	  | succ rounds ih =>

   101	/-- Repeated ceiling-halving of a positive number reaches one after its
   102	base-two ceiling logarithm number of rounds. -/
   103	theorem roundLengthAfter_clog_two (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
   104	    roundLengthAfter (Nat.clog 2 n) n = 1 := by

   106	  | h n ih =>
   107	      by_cases hn_one : n ≤ 1
   108	      · have hn_eq : n = 1 := by omega
   109	        subst n
   110	        simp [roundLengthAfter]
   111	      · have hn_two : 2 ≤ n := by omega
   112	        let next := (n + 1) / 2
   113	        have hnext_pos : 0 < next := by
   114	          dsimp [next]
   115	          omega
   116	        have hnext_lt : next < n := by
   117	          dsimp [next]
   118	          omega
   119	        have hclog : Nat.clog 2 n = Nat.clog 2 next + 1 := by

   121	          congr 2
   122	        rw [hclog]
   123	        simp only [roundLengthAfter]
   124	        exact ih next hnext_lt hnext_pos

   129	
   130	theorem finalForest_length {inputs : List α} (h : inputs ≠ []) :

   138	/-- Extract the unique final tree. Empty input returns `none`. -/
   139	def reductionTree (inputs : List α) : Option (Tree α) :=

   141	  | [tree] => some tree
   142	  | _ => none
   143	
   144	@[simp] theorem forestLeafMultiset_append
   145	    (left right : List (Tree α)) :
   146	    forestLeafMultiset (left ++ right) =
   147	      forestLeafMultiset left + forestLeafMultiset right := by
   148	  simp [forestLeafMultiset]
   149	
   150	theorem forestLeafMultiset_combineHalves
   151	    (left right : List (Tree α)) :
   152	    forestLeafMultiset (combineHalves left right) =
   153	      forestLeafMultiset left + forestLeafMultiset right := by
   154	  induction left generalizing right with
   155	  | nil => cases right <;> simp [combineHalves, forestLeafMultiset]
   156	  | cons tree trees ih =>
   157	      cases right with
